name: HRP Growth Theme
description: Hierarchical Risk Parity (Ward linkage) applied to growth-oriented assets: US equities (VUSA), Nasdaq-100 tech (EQQQ), thematic cloud computing (WCLD), India growth (IIND), and MSCI Europe (IMEU). Concentrates on secular growth exposure while using HRP clustering to diversify across geographies and sectors within the growth universe.
